description: Complete per-store stock, seller, fulfillment and scenario richness assumptions; prices are built solely from catalog bounds and declared positions.

source.notice: WorldMock simulation assumptions; eight meals per restaurant with three unique dishes per menu pair, forty convenience/merchant goods with six final categories, eighty supermarket goods with eight final categories, eight real raw ingredients with two ingredient categories. Prices, positions and stock are not observed retail facts.
source.applicability: January-March 2026 simulation. Eight distinct raw ingredients plus one complete cooking package; no claim of actual named-store menus or retail prices.
